messages:
lucy (design): Quick run-through of the Private setup wizard checklist UI. Current problem: long prereq lists push important actions off-screen on smaller laptops. Idea: make each prereq collapsible with a short summary line + severity icon so the list is scannable. marco (product): Love collapsible rows. Also want a lightweight "Mark as resolved" action for customers who fixed network rules out-of-band and want to re-run only specific probes. Avoid making it destructive. rachel (frontend): Implementation notes: collapsible rows should be keyboard operable (Enter/Space to toggle). Use aria-controls to point to the panel and aria-expanded on the button. Example snippet: ```
...
``` den (eng): Backend can tag probe types and return a short summary text so frontend doesn't have to parse logs. We'll add an endpoint that returns {summary: string, severity: "ok|warn|fail", diagToken: string} — diagToken used to open the help drawer for that item. a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist: 1) Toggle controls must have accessible name and aria-expanded. 2) Add sr-only live update when a probe finishes: "SSH probe: failed after 3 attempts." 3) Ensure focus is preserved — don't move focus to newly revealed content unless user triggers it. oliver (qa): Add e2e case: collapse/expand via keyboard, focus order remains predictable, and mark-as-resolved triggers only local UI state (no accidental retries). Also test on 13" laptops. marco (product): Copy discussion: what should the collapsed summary say? Options: ["SSH unreachable — try opening port 22.", "Could not reach SSH on port 22.", "Network block detected for SSH."] Which is clearest? lucy (design): Prefer the first. It's action-oriented and short. We'll use an icon + short text. The expanded panel can show a one-line diagnostic and two CTAs: "Retry probe" and "Open troubleshooting guide" with the guide opening the drawer (not a new tab). rachel (frontend): Small accessibility note: if "Open troubleshooting guide" opens a drawer, move focus into the drawer heading, set aria-modal=false (non-blocking) and ensure Escape closes it. Use role="dialog" for the drawer region. a11y-bot: For non-modal drawers, don't trap focus. Instead set initial focus to the drawer title and ensure the opener has aria-expanded toggled. Provide skip links in the drawer to jump back to the checklist. den (eng): Regarding "Mark as resolved": we'll implement it as a local override flag and emit an analytics event so we can correlate with support tickets. We'll also add rate limits so customers don't abuse it to hide real issues. oliver (qa): For tests, add a case verifying analytics payload contains diagToken but not raw IPs or logs. Sanitization is a must. figma-bot: Updated frames: https://figma.com/file/zxy7-setup-checklist (frames: Checklist-collapsed/Checklist-expanded/Drawer-troubleshoot). lucy (design): Visual nit: when multiple items are warned, ensure the summary row uses an accessible color palette and the icon has an accessible label (aria-hidden on icon + text label). rachel (frontend): Perf note: collapsing many rows can cause reflow. We'll virtualize long lists and animate height with CSS transforms where possible. Also debounce retries and status updates to 250ms to avoid rapid DOM thrash. a11y-bot: VoiceOver tip: ensure the toggle communicates new status when expanded (e.g., append "— details shown" to the accessible name). marco (product): Plan: ship collapsible checklist, local mark-as-resolved, and help drawer with sanitized diag in next sprint. I'll update the PR template with copy and analytics requirements. den (eng): I'll add the diagToken and summary to the probe API. Rachel, I'll ping you for integration. oliver (qa): I'll draft e2e and manual a11y testcases and add to the regression board. lucy (design): Thanks all — this should reduce cognitive load and speed up troubleshooting for customers. :sparkles:
